title: drosera glabripes
intro: Drosera glabripes, commonly known as the swamp sundew, is a carnivorous plant species belonging to the Droseraceae family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Drosera glabripes include its anti-inflammatory, expectorant, and antispasmodic properties, which help to relieve coughs, congestion, and digestive discomfort. The bioactive constituents of Drosera glabripes include iridoids, phenolic compounds, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
